plain_frame: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target is the empty botanical playing-card frame. Remove BOTH blank index cartouches entirely including gold tips. Continue the same narrow dark botanical band and thin gold inner rule through those vacated areas. One perfectly regular narrow rectangular botanical perimeter all around. The large flat antique white #FAEBD7 interior must be a centered rounded rectangle with equal top and bottom insets and equal left and right insets, straight parallel sides. Keep the antique-white outer ground, gold beads, fine gold rules, detailed ivory flowers with red petal tips, red berries, olive and gold acanthus, and near-black botanical band. Keep the same 5:7 canvas, flat artwork full bleed, no pips, no text, no cartouches, no extra flowers inside the empty field. Upper and lower center of the horizontal frame may have a simple symmetric white rosette. Crucial: left and right vertical border bands have exactly the same width. This is a reusable production FRAME COMPONENT; preserve the existing quality and narrow border proportions.
frame: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the edit target and botanical style reference. Create one reusable EMPTY playing-card frame and field master for a pixel-perfect deck rebuild. Retain the narrow near-black botanical perimeter, gold beads and gold rules, intricate ivory/red flowers, olive and antique-gold foliage, flat illustration style. Remove ALL ten central spade emblems completely and ALL rank text and suit marks. Retain the two opposing index cartouches but make their interiors blank antique white. Make the large rounded rectangular playing field clean, uninterrupted, flat antique white #FAEBD7 with no filigree or ornament inside it; blank space is intentional for compositing existing artwork. Use antique white #FAEBD7 also for the outer card ground and blank index panels. Frame, rules, flowers, outline, and cartouches must be exactly balanced under 180-degree rotation. Thin perimeter follows the supplied geometry, with narrow bands and plenty of inner room. Outer corners radius about 5.5% of card width (3.5 mm on a 63.5 mm card). Full card fills image, exact 5:7 portrait proportions, preferably 1500x2100. Crisp production illustration, no shadow, no perspective, no text, no symbols, no mockup. Preserve the gold contour and small decorative gold tips on the blank cartouches. The result is a reusable background, not a playable card.
